visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair, wearing a yellow and cream-colored t-shirt and grey shorts, sits on a plush grey sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room. He uses his bare toes to carefully press down the white teeth of a green plastic toy crocodile on the floor. A woman's hand briefly enters the frame to stabilize the toy. (2) The boy continues to press the teeth one by one with his right foot. He looks down at the toy with intense focus, his mouth slightly open in concentration. After each successful press that doesn't trigger the snap, he looks up at the camera with wide eyes and raises his hands in a playful, defensive gesture. (3) The boy persists in his unique game, his movements rhythmic and focused. Various yellow text overlays appear in the center of the frame as he works through the teeth. The background shows soft, light-colored cushions and a wooden partition in a domestic setting. (4) The crocodile's mouth suddenly snaps shut on the boy's toe. He reacts instantly with wide eyes and an open mouth in a look of exaggerated surprise. He pulls his foot back and erupts into laughter, waving his hands and looking directly at the camera with high energy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic background music theme featuring digital synthesizer textures. A sharp, plastic 'click' sound effect coincides with the start of the video. An adult female voice speaks with a friendly, guiding tone, and the child's breathing is faintly audible over the clean room tone. (2) Each time the child presses a tooth, a repetitive percussive 'click' occurs, followed by the child's voice saying '沒事' (it's okay) in a calm, repetitive manner. The BGM continues with a steady, rhythmic pulse, maintaining a playful and suspenseful energy as the game progresses. (3) A loud, sharp impact sound marks the moment the toy crocodile's mouth snaps shut. The child immediately emits a high-pitched, high-arousal shout of surprise. This sound event triggers an immediate transition into loud, hearty laughter from both the child and a woman, layered over the continuing energetic music.
